name: Hansong (nanjing)
summary: Hansong Nanjing Technologies Ltd. focuses on the entire lifecycle of audio and video consumer electronic products, from initial design and development through to manufacturing. The company is also deeply involved in advancing audio technologies through dedicated research and development efforts, supplying premium audio offerings, and delivering comprehensive technical solutions. Hansong has solidified its leading position within the audio industry by specializing in sophisticated capabilities such as high-performance audio signal processing, amplification, transmission, and intelligent audio system integration. Established on August 21, 2003, the firm's main operational base is located in Nanjing, China.
